svg.title: Folders: open another folder, add it to the session
svg.desc: Mock: the session's folders chip and popover, the workspace menu that opens another folder into the workspace, and how each harness applies an extra folder. Invented data.
svg.text: More than one folder: workspace roots vs. session folders

g.text: Wire the docs build to the API
Link acme-docs/README.md to the new /auth/refresh route
I can read both folders. Updating the route table in acme-docs and the
The agent can read and edit these. Relative paths resolve in the first.
Claude Code: applied through ACP additionalDirectories
Added folders are readable without prompts; edits follow the permission mode.

svg.text: The popover's last line says how the harness applies it:
applied now: ACP additionalDirectories on session/new, load, resume, fork (adapter 0.98 advertises it)
applied now: /add-dir <path> as a local command (no model call, not in the transcript)
applies to the next turn: sandboxPolicy workspaceWrite.writableRoots on turn/start
OMP and Claude Code: Hutan pastes `/add-dir <path>` at the prompt; Codex: restart with --add-dir
needs a restart: the Seatbelt profile is fixed at spawn, extra_write gains the folder
green: takes effect immediately · amber: next turn, a paste, or a restart (the popover names which)
Open another folder in the workspace
Add Folder to the Focused Session…
Add Folder to This Workspace… is always there. In a workspace it is
`workspace.add_root`; in a lone project it first makes a workspace around the project
(`workspace.create {name, project_ids}`) and moves the layout with it, as joining
A session folder is not a project: adding one never adds a sidebar row. The daemon's file
service already accepts every folder of a session (docs/protocol.md § Paths and
confinement); the extra folders join that set while the session lives.
Adding a folder widens what an agent can touch, so it is user-only like
request never raises its caller's privileges).
Prior art: Zed multi-root projects (agents read and write across all folders), Cursor
multi-root workspaces in the Agents Window, Claude Desktop “+ → Add folder” while a
session runs, Conductor `/add-dir` linking other workspaces.
